newsitem.title: USA: US June S&P 500s hit fresh daily high late, end up.
newsitem.headline: US June S&P 500s hit fresh daily high late, end up.

text.p: April 15 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures rallied from the session low at 749.50 to hit a fresh daily high of 759.90 late. They closed sharply higher. Recovery began once T-bond futures closed, traders noted. They cited short-covering and technicals on the good volume rally. Traders peg resistance early Wednesday at 761.50. Benign CPI set the tone early.
